keepDays.label: Keep a bag for (days)
keepDays.help: A customer's bag stays on this phone or computer for this many days after the last change.

duplicateAdd.label: The same item added again
duplicateAdd.help: Block: the customer is told it is already in the bag. Add one more: the quantity goes up by one.

repeatGuardMs.label: Ignore a second tap within (milliseconds)
repeatGuardMs.help: A double tap on "Add to bag" inside this time is the same add. 0 = off.

addBehaviour.label: After "Add to bag"
addBehaviour.help: Sheet: the added-to-bag panel opens (a sheet on the phone, a drawer on a computer). Toast: a short message. Page: go to the bag.

style.label: Added-to-bag panel look
style.help: Default: the item just added and the bag total. B: every line of the bag, the new one marked "Just added".

maxLines.label: Bag lines shown in the panel
maxLines.help: 0 = as many as fit; the rest show as "+N more items · View bag".

fill.label: Recommendations in the panel
fill.help: Fit: as many as fit below the buttons, then "+N more". Fixed: the number below. Off: none.

picks.label: Most recommendations in the panel
picks.help: The largest number of "Complete the look" items the panel offers.

gapPx.label: Space under the buttons (pixels)
gapPx.help: The recommendations start at least this far below the panel's buttons.

enabled.label: "Save for later" in the bag
enabled.help: A line can be put aside in the bag and moved back with one tap.

undoMs.label: "Undo" message shows for (milliseconds)
undoMs.help: After Remove or Save for later. It waits while the mouse or keyboard is on it.

lowStockAt.label: Say "Only N left" at (pieces)
lowStockAt.help: 0 = never. With a number, a line with that many pieces or fewer left says so.

securePayment.label: Show "Secure payment" under the total
securePayment.help: Switch it on once online payment is live.

whatsappHelp.label: "Questions? Message us on WhatsApp" in the bag
whatsappHelp.help: Shows only when the store has a WhatsApp number.

enabled.label: The offer slot under the bag's lines
enabled.help: One place under the lines for a set offer or the free-delivery gap; hidden when there is nothing true to say.

enabled.label: "Buy more, pay less" tiers in the bag
enabled.help: The tiers of the live "Build your own set" rules for an item in the bag.

endsOn.label: Tiers show until (day)
endsOn.help: Empty = no end day. The last day still counts.

max.label: Most tiers shown
max.help: Up to 4 tiers of one rule.

phonePreview.label: Show the tiers on the phone too
phonePreview.help: The tier box is for computers; on the phone it is a preview for the owner to try.

enabled.label: "Same product in two sizes" card
enabled.help: Asks once whether one is for someone else, or helps pick the size.

enabled.label: "Have a code?" in the bag
enabled.help: The discount code box. Each code says itself who can use it.

enabled.label: Free-delivery progress in the bag
enabled.help: "Add ৳X more for free delivery", from the live free-delivery rule only.

enabled.label: "Goes well with your bag" row
enabled.help: Products from the same category as the bag first, never one already in it.

count.label: Products in the row
count.help: How many products the row offers.

style.label: Row look on a computer
style.help: Side: the tier ladder beside the cards. Current: the plain row.

reasons.label: Reasons to buy under the row
reasons.help: Cash on Delivery and the size exchange, each only when it is switched on in the store.

originalLine.label: Say "100% original" under the row
originalLine.help: Switch it on only when every product is genuine stock.
